content:
TEMPTATION ||| Slide my fingers over the blade's surface ||| "Let’s see how they react when I speak the truth."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing the grip on the blade ||| "I won't answer until the truth is clearer."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, the weight of the moment heavy ||| "I feel lost in this, but I trust you."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade tighter, taking control ||| "I’ll decide what’s revealed here, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, letting the moment stretch |||
